edges.description: UE initiates initial registration (e.g., 5GS services, emergency)
; Send REGISTRATION REQUEST, Start T3510
AMF receives REGISTRATION REQUEST from UE
; Process REGISTRATION REQUEST, May initiate common procedures
Registration accepted AND REGISTRATION COMPLETE required
; Send REGISTRATION ACCEPT (requiring COMPLETE), Start T3550
Registration accepted AND REGISTRATION COMPLETE NOT required
; Send REGISTRATION ACCEPT (not requiring COMPLETE)
Registration cannot be accepted (e.g., congestion, not allowed)
; Send REGISTRATION REJECT
UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT requiring COMPLETE
REG ACCEPT requires COMPLETE; Stop T3510, Reset counter, Store context
UE receives REGISTRATION ACCEPT NOT requiring COMPLETE
REG ACCEPT does NOT require COMPLETE; Stop T3510, Reset counter, Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED
UE receives REGISTRATION REJECT
Based on 5GMM cause; Stop T3510, Perform actions based on cause
UE sends REGISTRATION COMPLETE
; Send REGISTRATION COMPLETE, Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED
AMF receives REGISTRATION COMPLETE
; Receive REG COMPLETE, Stop T3550, Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED
T3510 expires AND registration attempt counter < 5
Registration attempt counter < 5; Stop T3510, Increment counter, Restart procedure
T3510 expires AND registration attempt counter = 5
Registration attempt counter = 5; Stop T3510, Set counter=5, Delete context, Start T3502
Lower layer failure/release OR TAI change OR Tx failure
Transmission failure of REG COMPLETE OR TAI change before sending COMPLETE
T3550 expires (1st to 4th time)
Retransmission counter < 5; Retransmit REG ACCEPT, Restart T3550
T3550 expires (5th time)
Retransmission counter = 5; Abort procedure, Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED

; Abort procedure, Enter 5GMM-REGISTERED
